name: Pistol Speed Option Pitch & Space Read

summary.motive: Create a 2-on-1 space dilemma on the perimeter edge in short-yardage / red-zone situations using speed option mechanics from pistol.
summary.whyItWorks: Leaving the defensive end unblocked allows offensive linemen to climb immediately to the second level; the QB forces the edge defender to commit before pitching to elite speed in space.
summary.failureMode: Defensive end slow-playing the option to disrupt the pitch track while scraping linebackers rally to tackle the QB before he can release the pitch.

beats.title: 1. The Pistol Speed Option Launch
beats.text: The QB takes the pistol snap and sprints aggressively toward the right edge, attacking the outside shoulder of unblocked defensive end SDE while RB maintains a 4-yard pitch track.

beats.title: 2. The Edge Read & Pitch Decision
beats.text: SDE turns his shoulders and commits downhill to tackle the sprinting QB. The QB flips a clean option pitch into space to the sprinting RB.

beats.title: 3. Violent Lead Block in the Alley
beats.text: Fullback FB inserts into the perimeter alley and delivers a thunderous lead block on the filling strong safety, completely clearing the edge lane.

beats.title: 4. Red Zone Pylon Touchdown Burst
beats.text: The running back turns the corner at 21 mph, beating the diving free safety to the front pylon for an electrifying 15-yard red zone touchdown.

relations.tell: QB attacks outside shoulder of unblocked DE on a fast lateral option track with RB in parallel pitch relationship.
